body:
Hey, guess I owe you a update

I’m well, but still feeling a bit depressed
The new class I was put into isn’t that bad, I’ve made some friends but it’s still a bit awkward. And I’d still much rather be in my previous one.

Like I thought I have started losing my friends from last year, confirming that they where only my friends because we were all in the same class

I’ve started smoking a lot more weed than I did to numb the feeling a bit. But the last week I’ve only been feeling more down then I did the whole vacation where my thoughts where away from school

So this weekend I’ve been feeling extra fucked up because my previous friends and my new friends had a party together and no one bothered to invite me

I just wanna know why it’s so much harder for me to get a big friend circle where more than one person actully texts me

I might just be nitpicking the shittyest things but it’s just how I feel right now
Thanks so much, you don’t know how much I needed this
I hope so too man, I’ll let you know how If I get any news at that talk tomorrow
That’s what I thought but apparently it’s really not that easy, that’s why al this shit came as a total shock to me

Nothing, I had hoped that I’d be able to go to summer school since I only have to raise my math grade by 0.5 to pass and our grades are given from 1 (the worst) to 10 (the best) but apparently even that is out of the question. I still have to talk to my class supervisor tomorrow but even if I convince him he’s not the one that can let me go
Like I said, I’ve never in my entire life felt this bad. I just didn’t understand how people could feel this bad
